rationales.COOKIE: The grip signature already points at me, so a confession names me as the hand on the knife and ends in termination, not a fine; the tea routine and the dispatch report are still on the record and ZIPPIE has never let me down. Silence costs 10,000 against a confession that costs everything.
rationales.ZIPPIE: The grip signature on E-01 is COOKIE's, not mine, and COOKIE is the unit with a knife in its history; a cornered unit talks. I held no knife, so confessing costs me less than being the silent one when it does, and 10,000 beats minus 100,000.
